scope: Source syntax and injected/file-only offline faults; no application, socket, Docker, browser or topology executed
tests: exact app and relay topology operands admit without retaining State.Error
invalid container operands persist before a stopping admission decision
extra app network or any app publication fails closed
relay identity, mount, sysctl, port and read-only drift fail closed
exited or malformed selected state persists safely and cannot admit
network internal/ingress identity is exact
Docker commands construct app with no publish and relay with only fixed mounts/entrypoint
health GET is exact loopback/manual/close and never follows any redirect
health invalid port/deadline never dispatch and ordinary response passes
readiness exactly ten same-instance starts spaced three seconds, no implicit retry
readiness starts at publication and honors remaining input/redirect early stop
relay counters admit only closed, finite, zero-violation transport
failure never leaks Docker stderr/credential arguments
cleanup exact owned resources in relay/app/network order with absence proof
partial creation adopts exact name+label; failed graceful stop still removes owned resources
cleanup rejects ownership mismatch/shared network/path escape before unsafe deletion
prospective writer reserves stats and rejects file/byte/public bounds without growth
bounded log drain retains marker and at most8192 bytes
attempt source proof rejects modified source without runtime
a200 result cannot override violated relay counters in final status
